name: queens_n8__v10_nh
prompt:
Place 8 queens on a 8×8 chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Queens attack along rows, columns, and diagonals.

Return a list of 8 integers where the i-th integer is the column position (0 to 7) of the queen in row i, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no solution exists.
